name: Amaranth Root Rot
description: A soil-borne fungal disease causing root decay, wilting, and plant death in amaranth. It is favored by poorly drained soils and continuous amaranth cultivation.
symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of leaves starting from lower leaves
Brown discoloration of roots and lower stem
Root decay with reduced root system
Fungal growth visible on roots in wet conditions
causes: Fusarium spp. and Rhizoctonia solani fungi
High soil temperatures with excess moisture
prevention: Plant in well-drained beds or ridges
Practice crop rotation with non-leafy crops
Incorporate organic matter to improve soil structure
